# Locations & Battles

## Aden {#aden}

Aden is a fortified town situated on a promontory connected to the mainland by a narrow isthmus, boasting octagon minarets and a history as a wealthy commercial hub before its 1839 capture by the English.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P10](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0010), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P11](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0011), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P12](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0012), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P13](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0013), +9 more_

## Africa {#africa}

Africa is a continent bounded by close shores near [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe) along the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean) Sea, possessing a cape known as the Cape of [Good Hope](../codex/places.md#good-hope).

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P63](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0063), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P64](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0064), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P65](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0065), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P66](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0066), +6 more_

## Amazon {#amazon}

The Amazon is a river whose vast estuary's embouchure is large enough to freshen the sea-water for a distance of several leagues and whose fresh-water current carries animals like the petromyzons-pricka out to sea.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XVII FROM CAPE HORN TO THE AMAZON P9](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0009), [v2 CHAPTER XVII FROM CAPE HORN TO THE AMAZON P10](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0010), [v2 CHAPTER XVII FROM CAPE HORN TO THE AMAZON P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011), [v2 CHAPTER XVII FROM CAPE HORN TO THE AMAZON P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), +6 more_

## America {#america}

America is a landmass with shores that receive cold water counter-currents, which skirt its coast, and connected to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe) via an underwater telegraphic cable.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P35](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0035), [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P36](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0036), [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P37](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0037), [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P38](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0038), +20 more_

**Associated with:** [Commander Farragut](../character/commander-farragut.md)

## Antarctic {#antarctic}

Enclosed by a massive ice cap, the Antarctic regions encompass volcanic lands rich in scoriae and lava, support a sparse vegetation of lichens and seaweeds, and are home to vast populations of sea birds, marine life, and seals.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG P35](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0035), [v2 CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG P36](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0036), [v2 CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG P37](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0037), [v2 CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG P38](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0038), +18 more_

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) navigates through the treacherous Antarctic ice pack until it becomes completely blocked by an immense iceberg barrier. Captain Nemo proposes diving under the ice fields to reach the [South Pole](../codex/places.md#south-pole), and after discussing the logistics with [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), he prepares the vessel and dives into the ocean depths to continue the journey south.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG P2](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0002), [v2 CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG P4](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0004), [v2 CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG P12](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0012), [v2 CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG P35](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0035)_

> Captain Nemo and [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) disembark on Antarctic land, claiming it as uncharted territory before exploring the area's unique flora and fauna alongside [Conseil](../character/conseil.md). Heavy fog and snow prevent [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) from taking solar measurements to confirm their exact position at the [South Pole](../codex/places.md#south-pole). With the March equinox approaching, [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) explains how he plans to use the sun's position and a chronometer the following day to verify if they have truly reached the Pole.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE P5](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0005), [v2 CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE P13](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0013), [v2 CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE P31](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0031), [v2 CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE P36](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0036)_

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) collides with an overturned iceberg and is tipped onto its side beneath the ice. Captain Nemo manages to right the vessel, but as they attempt to navigate out of the ice tunnel, both the forward and rear exits are blocked by shifting icebergs, trapping the ship completely.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XV ACCIDENT OR INCIDENT?

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XV ACCIDENT OR INCIDENT? P0](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0000), [v2 CHAPTER XV ACCIDENT OR INCIDENT? P23](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0023), [v2 CHAPTER XV ACCIDENT OR INCIDENT? P42](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0042), [v2 CHAPTER XV ACCIDENT OR INCIDENT? P60](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0060)_

## Antilles {#antilles}

The Antilles are associated with a submarine valley that terminates in an immense depression and includes a sheer perpendicular cliff extending toward the Lesser Antilles.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XVII FROM CAPE HORN TO THE AMAZON P9](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0009), [v2 CHAPTER XVII FROM CAPE HORN TO THE AMAZON P10](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0010), [v2 CHAPTER XVII FROM CAPE HORN TO THE AMAZON P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011), [v2 CHAPTER XVII FROM CAPE HORN TO THE AMAZON P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), +12 more_

## Arabia {#arabia}

Arabia is a region with curious coasts situated near the Sea of [Oman](../codex/places.md#oman), which separates it from the [Indian Peninsula](../codex/places.md#indian-peninsula).

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P63](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0063), [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P64](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0064), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P0](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0000), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P1](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0001), +21 more_

## Asia {#asia}

Asia is a landmass situated to the west of the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) Ocean whose coast is skirted by the Kuro-Scivo current after it leaves the [Gulf](../codex/places.md#gulf) of Bengal and passes through the Straits of Malacca.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII SOME FIGURES P44](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0044), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P0](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P1](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), +14 more_

## Atlantis {#atlantis}

Atlantis is an engulfed ancient continent situated under the ocean, featuring ruined Tuscan architecture, aqueducts, an acropolis, and broad sunken streets.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER IX A VANISHED CONTINENT P45](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0045), [v2 CHAPTER IX A VANISHED CONTINENT P46](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0046), [v2 CHAPTER IX A VANISHED CONTINENT P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047), [v2 CHAPTER IX A VANISHED CONTINENT P48](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0048), +12 more_

## Australia {#australia}

Australia is a continent off whose eastern coast the steamer [Governor Higginson](../codex/tech.md#governor-higginson) encountered a fast-moving, mysterious nautical phenomenon in July 1866.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 PART ONE P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 PART ONE P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 PART ONE P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), +4 more_

## Bab-el-mandeb {#bab-el-mandeb}

Bab-el-mandeb, whose name means "The Gate of Tears" in Arabic, is a narrow strait twenty miles wide and thirty-two miles long that serves as an entrance connecting the [Gulf](../codex/places.md#gulf) of [Aden](../codex/places.md#aden) and the [Indian Ocean](../codex/places.md#indian-ocean) to the [Red Sea](../codex/places.md#red-sea).

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P1](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0001), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P2](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0002), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P3](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0003), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P4](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0004), +17 more_

## Brest {#brest}

Brest is a French location featuring an arsenal foundry that existed around 1785, and it served as the departure point for the French merchantmen [Recherche](../codex/tech.md#recherche) and Esperance in September 1791.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P22](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P23](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P24](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), +12 more_

## Brooklyn {#brooklyn}

Brooklyn is a location featuring a pier and quay where the frigate [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) was moored and departed on its expedition.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P15](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P16](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P18](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0018), +19 more_

## Cadiz {#cadiz}

Cadiz is a port city whose merchants held the exclusive right to receive all merchandise arriving from the West Indies, and its distance from [India](../codex/places.md#india) is shortened by the [Suez](../codex/places.md#suez) Canal.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P53](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0053), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P54](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0054), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P55](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0055), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P56](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0056), +20 more_

## Calcutta {#calcutta}

Calcutta is a port city where Captain [Dillon](../character/dillon.md) secured support from the Asiatic Society and the Indian Company for his expedition to [Vanikoro](../codex/places.md#vanikoro), and to which he later returned before traveling to [France](../codex/places.md#france).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P27](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P29](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P30](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0030), +9 more_

## Cancer {#cancer}

The Tropic of Cancer is a line of latitude crossed by both the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) and the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) during their voyages through the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) Ocean.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P8](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P9](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P10](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), +14 more_

## Cape Horn {#cape-horn}

Cape Horn is a solitary island rock located at the southern extremity of the [American](../codex/factions.md#american) continent that was named by Dutch sailors after their native town.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P38](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P0](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P1](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P2](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0002), +16 more_

## Capricorn {#capricorn}

The tropic of Capricorn is a geographical line of latitude crossed by the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) during its journey toward the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P8](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P9](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P10](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P11](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0011), +14 more_

## Ceylon {#ceylon}

Ceylon is an island featuring a range of capricious mountains about two thousand feet high, located off the [Indian Peninsula](../codex/places.md#indian-peninsula) and noted for its pearl fisheries in places like the [Gulf](../codex/places.md#gulf) of Manaar.

_Sources: [v2 PART TWO P11](../source/v02-c00.md#nw-v02-c00-p0011), [v2 PART TWO P12](../source/v02-c00.md#nw-v02-c00-p0012), [v2 PART TWO P13](../source/v02-c00.md#nw-v02-c00-p0013), [v2 PART TWO P14](../source/v02-c00.md#nw-v02-c00-p0014), +16 more_

> Captain Nemo leads [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) on a diving excursion off the coast of Ceylon to explore the pearl oyster banks, where they discover a giant tridacne oyster harboring an enormous pearl. While observing an Indian pearl diver, a shark attacks the fisherman. Captain Nemo and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) battle and kill the shark, saving the diver from death.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P25](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0025), [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P31](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0031), [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P40](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0040), [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P46](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0046)_

## China {#china}

China is a distant country to which the servant [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) was willing to travel, and its adjacent seas served as a searching ground for the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) during its hunt for the mysterious sea monster.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P2](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P3](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P4](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0004), +14 more_

## Crespo {#crespo}

Crespo is a small desert island in the [North Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific), also recorded on old Spanish maps as Rocca de la [Plata](../codex/places.md#plata), which features underwater forests.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P15](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P16](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P17](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P18](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0018), +32 more_

## Crete {#crete}

Crete, also known anciently as Candia, is an island situated near [Rhodes](../codex/places.md#rhodes) and Carpathos whose population had risen in insurrection against the despotism of the Turks.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO P48](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0048), [v2 CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO P49](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0049), [v2 CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO P50](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0050), [v2 CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO P51](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0051), +24 more_

## Egypt {#egypt}

Egypt is a country with curious coasts near [Arabia](../codex/places.md#arabia) whose historical plain contains traces of an ancient canal built across it to connect the [Nile](../codex/places.md#nile) to the [Red Sea](../codex/places.md#red-sea).

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P5](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0005), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P7](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0007), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P8](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0008), +14 more_

## England {#england}

England is a practical nation that took reports of an unknown, gigantic aquatic creature more seriously than light-thinking people who jested about it.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 PART ONE P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 PART ONE P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 PART ONE P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), +5 more_

## Europe {#europe}

Europe is a continent linked to [America](../codex/places.md#america) by a transatlantic telegraph cable that transmits electric signals between the two landmasses in fractions of a second.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P39](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0039), [v2 CHAPTER XX FROM LATITUDE 47° 24′ TO LONGITUDE 17° 28′ P0](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0000), [v2 CHAPTER XX FROM LATITUDE 47° 24′ TO LONGITUDE 17° 28′ P1](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0001), [v2 CHAPTER XX FROM LATITUDE 47° 24′ TO LONGITUDE 17° 28′ P2](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0002), +7 more_

## France {#france}

France is a European nation whose government attached Assistant Professor Pierre [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) to an expedition to Nebraska and later conducted inquiries into the potential existence of a submarine war machine.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P17](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0017), [v1 PART ONE P18](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0018), [v1 PART ONE P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019), [v1 PART ONE P20](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0020), +13 more_

**Associated with:** [Admiral Chateau-Renaud](../character/admiral-chateau-renaud.md), [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md)

## Gibraltar {#gibraltar}

Gibraltar is home to a narrow straits connecting the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean) Sea and the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic) Ocean, containing an upper current flowing into the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean) and an under-current that empties into the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic).

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER VII THE MEDITERRANEAN IN FORTY-EIGHT HOURS P21](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0021), [v2 CHAPTER VII THE MEDITERRANEAN IN FORTY-EIGHT HOURS P22](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0022), [v2 CHAPTER VII THE MEDITERRANEAN IN FORTY-EIGHT HOURS P23](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0023), [v2 CHAPTER VII THE MEDITERRANEAN IN FORTY-EIGHT HOURS P24](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0024), +12 more_

## Gilboa {#gilboa}

Gilboa is an island surrounded by a coral reef and covered in dense forests of [Papuan](../codex/places.md#papua) flora, including screw-pines and abundant bread-fruit trees.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P11](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P12](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P13](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P14](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0014), +26 more_

> [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) go ashore on the island of Gilboa to harvest wild plant foods like breadfruit and coconuts. The following day, they return to hunt game, successfully acquiring pigeons, a bird of paradise, a wild hog, and several kangaroos. As they enjoy an elaborate dinner on the beach, their discussion of escaping the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) is interrupted by a falling stone.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P20](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P39](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P70](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P78](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0078)_

## Good Hope {#good-hope}

The Cape of Good Hope is a cape located around [Africa](../codex/places.md#africa) that links the [Indian Ocean](../codex/places.md#indian-ocean) to the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P105](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0105), [v1 CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA” P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA” P1](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA” P2](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0002), +25 more_

## Greenland {#greenland}

Greenland is associated with a species of inoffensive whale that is larger than the cachalot and generally does not pass through the warm equatorial waters.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XII CACHALOTS AND WHALES P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 CHAPTER XII CACHALOTS AND WHALES P27](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0027), [v2 CHAPTER XII CACHALOTS AND WHALES P28](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0028), [v2 CHAPTER XII CACHALOTS AND WHALES P29](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0029), +23 more_

## Gulf {#gulf}

_Not yet known._

## Gulf Stream {#gulf-stream}

The Gulf Stream is an ocean current resembling a salt river that flows into the middle of the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic) without mixing with ocean waters, known for its phosphorescent night waters, frequent tempests and cyclones, and a body of water larger than all the global rivers combined.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XVIII THE POULPS P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), [v2 CHAPTER XVIII THE POULPS P64](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0064), [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P0](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0000), [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P1](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0001), +6 more_

> [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) pressures [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) to ask Captain Nemo for their freedom as the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) sails along the [American](../codex/factions.md#american) coast near the Gulf Stream. [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) confronts [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) in his room, but [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) firmly rejects releasing them, declaring they must remain on board forever. Afterward, as the vessel reaches [Long Island](../codex/places.md#long-island), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) deliberately stays at the surface to brave a violent hurricane before finally submerging into the deep.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM

## Gulf of Mexico {#gulf-of-mexico}

The Gulf of Mexico is a body of water where a variety of trochi, remarkable for their imbricated shells, originate.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P94](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0094), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P95](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0095), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P96](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0096), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P97](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0097), +5 more_

## Havannah {#havannah}

_Not yet known._

## India {#india}

India is a distant destination whose maritime trade route from [Cadiz](../codex/places.md#cadiz) is shortened by the construction of the [Suez](../codex/places.md#suez) Canal, and which conducts commercial affairs through the counting-house of Djeddah.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P53](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0053), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P54](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0054), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P55](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0055), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P56](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0056), +5 more_

## Indian Ocean {#indian-ocean}

The Indian Ocean is a vast liquid plain covering an area of 1,200,000,000 acres, featuring waters so clear and transparent that looking over them can induce giddiness.

_Sources: [v2 PART TWO P2](../source/v02-c00.md#nw-v02-c00-p0002), [v2 PART TWO P3](../source/v02-c00.md#nw-v02-c00-p0003), [v2 PART TWO P4](../source/v02-c00.md#nw-v02-c00-p0004), [v2 PART TWO P5](../source/v02-c00.md#nw-v02-c00-p0005), +8 more_

## Indian Peninsula {#indian-peninsula}

The Indian Peninsula is a landmass located to the north-west of Keeling Island, from which the island of [Ceylon](../codex/places.md#ceylon) hangs like a pearl.

## Ireland {#ireland}

Ireland is a European country and island whose coast lies connected to [America](../codex/places.md#america) via a transatlantic electric telegraph cable.

## Italy {#italy}

Italy is one of several nations where official inquiries led to the rejection of the submarine warship hypothesis, and it is also the country where a inventor named Landi perfected a gun designed to fire underwater.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P5](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P6](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0006), +14 more_

## Japan {#japan}

Japan is a coastal region located less than two hundred miles from the frigate Abraham Lincoln's position in the northern [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific), and its surrounding waters host a diverse array of marine life, including unique mackerel and salamanders.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P16](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P17](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P18](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0018), +14 more_

## Jardin {#jardin}

The Jardin des Plantes is a French botanical location near Professor Aronnax's lodging and study, featuring a museum of natural history as well as animal cages where creatures like a Babiroussa can be displayed to the public.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P20](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P21](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P22](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), +23 more_

## Lawrence {#lawrence}

The St. Lawrence is one of the world's largest rivers, emptying its waters into the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic) Ocean.

## Liverpool {#liverpool}

Liverpool is a port city that serves as a terminus for steamships travelling to [New York](../codex/places.md#new-york) and whose departing vessels are guided by the light at Cape Clear.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P35](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0035), [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P36](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0036), [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P37](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0037), [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P38](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0038), +12 more_

## London {#london}

London is a city where Penn & Co. forged the screw shaft for the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) and where a cigar-like shape was previously adopted for similar constructions.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XI ALL BY ELECTRICITY P34](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XI ALL BY ELECTRICITY P35](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XI ALL BY ELECTRICITY P36](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XII SOME FIGURES P0](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0000), +14 more_

Long Island is a coastal location situated a few miles from the port of [New York](../codex/places.md#new-york).

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P34](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0034), [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P35](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0035), [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P36](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0036), [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P37](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0037), +6 more_

## Manche {#manche}

The Manche is a waterway to the east of Land's End and the Scilly Isles, situated near the coasts of [France](../codex/places.md#france) and [England](../codex/places.md#england).

## Marquesas {#marquesas}

The Marquesas are a group of charming islands protected by the French flag, featuring woody mountains such as Martin's peak on Nouka-Hiva, the largest island of the group.

## Mediterranean {#mediterranean}

The Mediterranean is a blue sea covering two million square yards and bordered by [Africa](../codex/places.md#africa) and [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe), known historically by various names such as the "great sea" of the Hebrews and "mare nostrum" of the Romans.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO P103](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0103), [v2 CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO P104](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0104), [v2 CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO P105](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0105), [v2 CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO P106](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0106), +16 more_

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the Mediterranean Sea at high speed, making escape impossible for [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md). [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) discuss geology and the eventual cooling of the Earth while navigating a shallow underwater ridge. On February 18th, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) passes through the Straits of [Gibraltar](../codex/places.md#gibraltar) and enters the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic) Ocean.
>

## Mississippi {#mississippi}

The Mississippi is one of the world's largest rivers, which empties its waters into the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic) Ocean and utilizes steamboats equipped with pilot cabins.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER V THE ARABIAN TUNNEL P52](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0052), [v2 CHAPTER V THE ARABIAN TUNNEL P53](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0053), [v2 CHAPTER V THE ARABIAN TUNNEL P54](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0054), [v2 CHAPTER V THE ARABIAN TUNNEL P55](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0055), +14 more_

## Nea Kamenni {#nea-kamenni}

Nea Kamenni is an island near [Santorin](../codex/places.md#santorin) around which recent submarine volcanic eruptions have occurred, resulting in the emergence of new islets like George Island, Aphroessa, and Reka.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO P95](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0095), [v2 CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO P96](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0096), [v2 CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO P97](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0097), [v2 CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO P98](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0098), +5 more_

## New Caledonia {#new-caledonia}

New Caledonia is a region featuring barrier reefs created by marine polypi, which is theorized to eventually be joined with [New Zealand](../codex/places.md#new-zealand) and neighboring island groups to stretch a fifth continent to the [Marquesas](../codex/places.md#marquesas).

## New York {#new-york}

New York is a city where Assistant Professor Pierre [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) arrived in late March following a research expedition in Nebraska, staying at the Fifth Avenue Hotel before embarking on an expedition aboard the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) from the [Brooklyn](../codex/places.md#brooklyn) pier.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P17](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0017), [v1 PART ONE P18](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0018), [v1 PART ONE P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019), [v1 PART ONE P20](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0020), +25 more_

> Pierre [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) arrives in New York and is consulted on the mysterious ocean monster. He publishes an article proposing that the phenomenon is an enormously large giant narwhal. Following reports of the creature in the [North Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific), [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) receives an invitation from the [United States](../codex/places.md#america) Secretary of Marine to join Commander Farragut's expedition aboard the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln).

## New Zealand {#new-zealand}

New Zealand is a region associated with the origin of the magnificent spur, a rare specimen of mollusc.

## Newfoundland {#newfoundland}

Newfoundland features a sea bank that is not very deep, consisting of organic alluvia, erratic blocks, and vast charnel-houses of molluscs.

## Nile {#nile}

The Nile is a river passing through [Egypt](../codex/places.md#egypt) whose waters were historically used as an intermediate route to connect the [Red Sea](../codex/places.md#red-sea) and the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean) via ancient canals.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P52](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0052), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P53](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0053), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P54](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0054), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P55](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0055), +14 more_

## North Atlantic {#north-atlantic}

The North Atlantic Ocean contains the [Sargasso Sea](../codex/places.md#sargasso-sea), a warm, seaweed-filled region surrounded by the circular currents of the [Gulf Stream](../codex/places.md#gulf-stream), as well as vast open stretches where the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) traveled while taking extremely deep soundings.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES P42](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0042), [v2 CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES P43](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0043), [v2 CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES P44](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0044), [v2 CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES P45](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0045), +9 more_

> [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) discuss their failed escape attempt and the Nautilus's current southward position. Later that night, Captain Nemo invites [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) on an underwater night excursion without lamps, guided by a glowing light in the distance. They trek across the ocean floor and climb an underwater volcano, revealing the sunken ruins of [Atlantis](../codex/places.md#atlantis).
>

## North Pacific {#north-pacific}

The Northern Pacific is an expansive oceanic region whose waters, along with the adjacent [Japanese](../codex/factions.md#japanese) and [American](../codex/factions.md#american) coasts, were thoroughly furrowed and explored by the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) during a three-month search for the sea monster.

On the return journey, Captain Nemo and his companion hunt a sea-otter and an albatross, and the group narrowly escapes two dangerous sharks before returning to the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus).
>

## Norway {#norway}

Norway is a country situated along a coast reached by the principal arm of the [Gulf Stream](../codex/places.md#gulf-stream) current.

> After escaping the maelstrom, Pierre [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) regains consciousness in a fisherman's hut in the Lofoten Isles alongside [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md). While awaiting transport to return to [France](../codex/places.md#france), [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) reflects on his ten-month underwater journey, revises his manuscript, and wonders about the ultimate fate of Captain Nemo and the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus).

## Oceania {#oceania}

Oceania is a region containing coral reefs and principal islands whose hydrographical bearings were fixed by the navigator [Dumont](../character/urville.md) d'Urville.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P65](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0065), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P66](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0066), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P67](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0067), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P68](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0068), +15 more_

## Oman {#oman}

Oman is a country featuring the prominent town of Muscat, which is surrounded by black rocks and distinguished by white houses, forts, mosques with rounded domes, and verdant terraces.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P63](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0063), [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P64](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0064), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P0](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0000), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P1](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0001), +15 more_

## Papua {#papua}

Papua is a region whose south-east point lies 750 leagues south-westerly from [Vanikoro](../codex/places.md#vanikoro) and whose coasts were sighted by the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) on January 4th.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P48](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0048), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P49](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0049), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P50](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0050), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P51](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0051), +13 more_

## Paris {#paris}

Paris is a city home to a Museum of Natural History, as well as the Museum of the Faculty of Medicine which houses a two-and-a-quarter-yard narwhal tusk.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P17](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0017), [v1 PART ONE P18](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0018), [v1 PART ONE P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019), [v1 PART ONE P20](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0020), +25 more_

## Plata {#plata}

Plata is a South [American](../codex/factions.md#american) coastal feature with a large estuary that was passed by the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) on its journey northward.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XVII FROM CAPE HORN TO THE AMAZON P8](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0008), [v2 CHAPTER XVII FROM CAPE HORN TO THE AMAZON P9](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0009), [v2 CHAPTER XVII FROM CAPE HORN TO THE AMAZON P10](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0010), [v2 CHAPTER XVII FROM CAPE HORN TO THE AMAZON P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011), +12 more_

## Prussia {#prussia}

Prussia is a nation where government inquiries were conducted regarding the mystery of a potential submarine war machine, and it is also the location of Krupp, the manufacturer that produced the engine for the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P5](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P6](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0006), +14 more_

## Quebec {#quebec}

Quebec is a town in Canada, formerly belonging to [France](../codex/places.md#france), that is home to a museum and was the original ancestral home of [Ned](../character/ned-land.md) Land's family of hardy fishermen.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P5](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P6](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P7](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P8](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0008), +14 more_

**Associated with:** [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)

## Red Sea {#red-sea}

Connected to the [Gulf](../codex/places.md#gulf) of [Aden](../codex/places.md#aden) via the Straits of [Bab-el-mandeb](../codex/places.md#bab-el-mandeb), the Red Sea is a narrow gulf notorious in ancient history for its hazardous storms, sandbanks, and currents, though its waters feature vibrant coral and microscopic seaweeds that can give certain areas a reddish appearance.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P1](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0001), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P2](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0002), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P3](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0003), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P4](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0004), +56 more_

> As the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the Red Sea, [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) discusses navigation and geology with [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) and later Captain Nemo. [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) reveals the existence of an underground passage beneath the Isthmus of [Suez](../codex/places.md#suez) that will allow them to reach the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean) without rounding [Africa](../codex/places.md#africa).
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P2](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0002), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P24](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0024), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P60](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0060), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P72](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0072)_

## Rhodes {#rhodes}

Rhodes is an island associated with a legendary serpent slain by Dieudonné de Gozon, and it is situated near the island of Scarpanto.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P40](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P41](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0041), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P42](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P43](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0043), +14 more_

## Santorin {#santorin}

Santorin is an island located in a volcanic area of the sea where submarine eruptions take place and new islets are formed.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO P93](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0093), [v2 CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO P94](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0094), [v2 CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO P95](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0095), [v2 CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO P96](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0096), +5 more_

## Sargasso Sea {#sargasso-sea}

Surrounded by the circular current of the [Gulf Stream](../codex/places.md#gulf-stream), the Sargasso Sea is a tranquil region of the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic) Ocean characterized by a dense carpet of seaweeds, tropical berries, and collected floating debris.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES P43](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0043), [v2 CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES P44](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0044), [v2 CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES P45](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0045), [v2 CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES P46](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0046), +8 more_

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) navigates through the seaweed-dense Sargasso Sea and then travels across the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic) Ocean. Captain Nemo takes the vessel to extreme deep-sea depths to conduct soundings and capture a photograph of the ocean floor before rapidly ascending to the surface.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XI THE SARGASSO SEA

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XI THE SARGASSO SEA P0](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0000), [v2 CHAPTER XI THE SARGASSO SEA P4](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0004), [v2 CHAPTER XI THE SARGASSO SEA P10](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0010), [v2 CHAPTER XI THE SARGASSO SEA P14](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0014)_

## South Pole {#south-pole}

Located at the ninetieth degree, the South Pole features a quiet marine basin used as a refuge by cetacea, bordered by a deserted continent of ice and volcanic rock dominated by a peak about five hundred yards high.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE P32](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0032), [v2 CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE P33](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0033), [v2 CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE P34](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0034), [v2 CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE P35](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0035), +15 more_

> On March 21st, Captain Nemo and [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) climb a volcanic peak on land to observe the sun during the equinox. Using their instruments and chronometer at precisely noon, [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) confirms that they have reached the South Pole and claims possession of the region under his own name.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE P42](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0042), [v2 CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE P43](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0043), [v2 CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044), [v2 CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE P46](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0046)_

## Spain {#spain}

Spain is a nation whose history includes the reign of Philip V, an early 18th-century conflict against a coalition formed by Holland, Austria, and [England](../codex/places.md#england), and the northwest coast location of [Vigo Bay](../codex/places.md#vigo-bay).

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P29](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0029), [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P31](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0031), [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), +13 more_

## Suez {#suez}

Suez is a location associated with an isthmus, a desert where General Bonaparte discovered traces of ancient canal works, and a canal project being constructed by M. [Lesseps](../character/lesseps.md) to connect the [Red Sea](../codex/places.md#red-sea) to the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean).

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P50](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0050), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P51](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0051), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P52](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0052), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P53](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0053), +11 more_

## Syria {#syria}

Syria is a region whose coast serves as a location where Captain Nemo retrieved tagged fish to confirm the existence of a subterranean passage from the [Red Sea](../codex/places.md#red-sea), and whose commercial ties extend to the trading port of Djeddah.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P74](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0074), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P75](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0075), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P76](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0076), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P77](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0077), +6 more_

## Torres Straits {#torres-straits}

The Torres Straits are a dangerous, nearly thirty-four-league-wide waterway connecting to the [Indian Ocean](../codex/places.md#indian-ocean) that is so heavily obstructed by islands, islets, breakers, and rocks as to make navigation almost impracticable.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P5](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P6](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P7](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P8](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0008), +21 more_

> As the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) navigates the treacherous Torres Straits, it runs aground near the Island of [Gilboa](../codex/places.md#gilboa). Captain Nemo remains confident that the upcoming full moon tide will free the ship. Taking advantage of the situation, [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) obtain permission to take a small boat to the island to hunt for fresh meat.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P16](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P26](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P40](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P41](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0041)_

## Vanikoro {#vanikoro}

Vanikoro is a group of green, verdant volcanic islands situated at 16° 4• S. lat. and 164° 32• E. long., featuring the 476-foot Mount Kapogo, the harbour of [Vanou](../codex/places.md#vanou), and surrounding coral reefs that were the site of the shipwreck of La Perouse's vessels.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P7](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P8](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P9](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), +46 more_

## Vanou {#vanou}

Vanou is a small harbor situated at 16° 4′ S. lat. and 164° 32′ E. long. on the island of [Vanikoro](../codex/places.md#vanikoro).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P16](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P17](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P18](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P19](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0019), +5 more_

## Vigo Bay {#vigo-bay}

Vigo Bay is an open, undefended road situated on the northwest coast of [Spain](../codex/places.md#spain) where Spanish treasure galleons were scuttled in 1702, leaving vast riches of gold and silver on its sandy sea floor that Captain Nemo later salvaged.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P37](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0037), [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P38](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0038), [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P39](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0039), [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P40](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0040), +21 more_

> [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) watches the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) crew collect gold and silver from sunken Spanish galleons in Vigo Bay. Captain Nemo explains how he gathers treasures from shipwrecks and hints that his vast wealth is used to aid suffering and oppressed humanity.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P52](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0052), [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P56](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0056), [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P63](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0063), [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P64](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0064)_
